faq.heading: Everything you want to know about our services.

questions.question: What core services does Al-Watad offer?
questions.answer: We provide integrated technology solutions, including: enterprise internet and communication services, social media account management and operations, cybersecurity and security auditing, technical support and managed services, digital transformation and process automation, data center implementation, website and smart application design, hosting and email services, data analytics and dashboards, and technology consulting and feasibility studies.

questions.question: Do you work only with government entities?
questions.answer: No, our services are available to both public and private sector clients, including educational institutions, banks, commercial enterprises, and non-profit organizations.

questions.question: Can you provide a customized social media marketing plan?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We create tailored monthly marketing plans for each client, covering content development, design, advertising campaigns, posting strategy, and performance analysis.

questions.question: How can I request a quote?
questions.answer: You can contact us via the Request a Quote form or by email. Just specify the service you’re interested in, and our team will respond within 24 to 48 hours with full details.

questions.question: Do you provide internet services directly?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer internet connectivity through various technologies, including: Fiber to the Home/Building (FTTH), Inter-branch connectivity (MPLS / VPN), Wireless networks and SD-WAN solutions.

questions.question: Can I request consultancy services only, without implementation?
questions.answer: Yes, we provide specialized consultancy services in cybersecurity, infrastructure, digital transformation, and network analysis. Consultations can be requested independently of implementation.

questions.question: Do you offer 24/7 technical support?
questions.answer: Yes, we provide round-the-clock technical support and managed services 7 days a week under clearly defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) signed with each client.

questions.question: How can I apply for a job at Al-Watad?
questions.answer: You can send your CV to: careers@al-watad.iq or visit our Careers page on the website.

about.title: About Al-Watad
about.companyProfile: Al-Watad is an Iraqi company specialized in delivering smart, integrated solutions across information systems, internet technologies, cybersecurity, social media management, and digital infrastructure services. We operate through expert teams and skilled local professionals, working in collaboration with world-class technology partners. Our mission is to provide high-quality, future-ready services that empower our clients—both in the public and private sectors—to strengthen their digital presence, protect their technical environment, and grow with confidence in an ever-evolving digital world.
about.vision: Driven by excellence in execution, service quality, operational performance, and competitive pricing, Al-Watad aims to expand its client base and become the preferred choice in the fields of information systems, telecommunication technologies, internet services, cybersecurity, and social media management by the year 2030.
about.mission: Our mission is to meet client requirements precisely as designed and planned—while offering consultative insight based on a deep understanding of their needs. We provide neutral, technically sound solutions throughout the entire project lifecycle, ensuring full alignment with objectives.
